features.name: Authentication & Security
features.description: PIN-based login system with master code reset functionality. Secure access control to the application.

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Main overview page displaying key metrics, statistics, and summary information about the society's operations including member counts, financial summaries, and quick access to recent activities.

features.name: Member Management
features.description: Complete member registration, profile management, and member details viewing. Includes member search, filtering, photo/signature upload, and comprehensive member information tracking.

features.name: Transaction Management
features.description: Daily transaction entry system for managing credits and debits across different account types (Savings, Loan, Shares, FD). Includes transaction history, filtering, and export capabilities.

features.name: Expense Management
features.description: Track and manage society expenses with categorization, receipt uploads, and expense reporting.

features.name: Bank Audit
features.description: Society bank account management and audit tracking. Manage multiple bank accounts, track balances, and maintain audit notes.

features.name: Loan Calculator
features.description: Calculate loan interest based on different schemes, principal amounts, and time periods. Supports various interest calculation methods.

features.name: Meeting Management
features.description: Record and manage society meetings including AGM, monthly, emergency, and committee meetings. Track attendees, resolutions, and generate meeting notices.

features.name: Paddy Purchase
features.description: Track paddy purchase records including member counts (tribal/non-tribal), bag types (new/old/used once), weights, and storage allocation (godown/shed/open). Includes cumulative storage tracking.

features.name: Dispatch Management
features.description: Manage paddy dispatch to mills with truck details, DO/TP numbers, storage source tracking, and bag usage.

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: Track inventory adjustments for bags and paddy stock including new stock entries, damage records, and corrections.

features.name: Reports & Analytics
features.description: Comprehensive reporting system including loan reports, NPA summary, bank incentive reports, member statements, and various financial reports. Supports CSV and PDF export with Marathi language support.

features.name: Settings & Configuration
features.description: Application settings including society information, financial year configuration, report header customization, board member management, security PIN changes, and backup/restore functionality.

features.name: AI Chat Assistant
features.description: Integrated AI chatbot widget powered by Google Generative AI for helping users with application features and queries.

features.name: Navigation & Layout
features.description: Responsive sidebar navigation with mobile support, route management, and consistent layout across the application.

features.name: Firebase Integration
features.description: Cloud data persistence and synchronization using Firebase Firestore and Authentication services.

features.name: Export Utilities
features.description: Utility functions for exporting data to CSV and PDF formats with proper filename handling for Unicode/Marathi characters.

features.name: Google Drive Backup
features.description: Backup and restore functionality using Google Drive integration for data persistence.

features.name: Security Components
features.description: Security PIN modal for sensitive operations and data protection.
